name: What is a double hung window and why should I consider replacing my old windows with them?

mainEntity.name: What is a double hung window and why should I consider replacing my old windows with them?

acceptedAnswer.text: A double hung window features two sashes that both slide vertically, allowing for versatile ventilation from either the top or bottom opening. This design makes cleaning easier and provides better airflow control compared to single hung windows. Homeowners often choose double hung windows for replacement due to their classic aesthetic, energy efficiency improvements from modern glazing and frames, and enhanced functionality, which can significantly improve comfort and reduce utility costs in homes across the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Double hung windows have two vertically sliding sashes for versatile ventilation and easier cleaning. They are a popular replacement choice for energy efficiency and classic aesthetics.
